info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Radars-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Radar API provides users with timely and accurate information about severe weather alerts. This service allows consumers to access current radar data and alerts, enabling them to stay informed about potential weather hazards in their area. Typical use cases include integration with weather applications, emergency response systems, and public safety notifications. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance their applications with real-time weather insights to improve user experience and safety.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve radar alerts data, providing crucial information about current alerts in the system. The alerts are essential for monitoring and response activities.

requestBody.description: This endpoint allows the client to request radar alerts information. The request body should contain the necessary parameters to fetch relevant radar alerts in JSON format.
